I’ve spent my whole career fighting to protect and expand voting rights, so this is personal to me.
**Donald Trump knows his support is collapsing under his historically unpopular agenda. He knows he can’t win fair and square. So he’s attacking your ability to hold him accountable.**
Across the nation, he’s sending Republicans to do his bidding and stack the deck. That’s why the YES campaign for redistricting in Virginia is so important. This is a critical opportunity to show Trump he won’t be allowed to bulldoze voting rights.

Happy birthday, Mom!

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129391128/614181063/1239926708?refcode=ea.5fcad0bf-6437-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.5fcad0bf-6437-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZmNhZDBiZi02NDM3LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lCP0eZnZJF0zJsQ1e0enPyRXvnjI_czMKroPVafbqJc=&emci=54160574-5337-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=5fcad0bf-6437-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=51844520) Friends, it’s Phil. April 13 is a date that matters a lot to me. It’s the day when, in 1945, my mom was born in Buchenwald, a Nazi concentration camp. **By every possible measure, her birth was a miracle.** And another miracle happened five days later, when U.S. Army soldiers from the 6th Armored Division liberated the camp, finding my grandmother (my Bubby, as I called her) and my newborn mom alive. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129391129/614181064/2078375028?refcode=ea.5fcad0bf-6437-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.5fcad0bf-6437-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZmNhZDBiZi02NDM3LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lCP0eZnZJF0zJsQ1e0enPyRXvnjI_czMKroPVafbqJc=)
Hitting the campaign trail is even better with family by your side. Over the last year, I have seen two remarkable depictions of the aftermath of the Holocaust, both of which highlight powerful lessons from the Holocaust and my family’s story: never again and the importance of hope in dark times. I strongly recommend them. The movie _Nuremberg_ captures the trials held for the Nazis who planned and executed the murder of 6 million Jews and 5 million non-Jews. In the movie, it explains that General (later President) Dwight Eisenhower insisted that the concentration camps be filmed because people would otherwise not believe what happened. And even with that evidence, Holocaust denial is on the rise, as are other conspiracy theories and anti-semitism more generally. A recent 60 Minutes episode about the Holocaust's youngest survivors tells the story of three women born in concentration camps. Their stories all echo the ones I heard from my Bubby, who was called out as being pregnant — an offense that warranted death — and managed to survive. As we look for sources of hope and guidance, I find them in memories of my Bubby, who believed wholeheartedly in a better future. **I also find hope and guidance in America’s commitments to justice, freedom, and opportunity for all.** Those commitments brought my family here after surviving the Holocaust. And they’re values I will always fight for as your next governor. **[I’d be honored if you’d make a contribution to this campaign, in honor of my mom’s birthday and the core values we all share.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129391130/614181065/2078375028?refcode=ea.5fcad0bf-6437-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.5fcad0bf-6437-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZmNhZDBiZi02NDM3LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lCP0eZnZJF0zJsQ1e0enPyRXvnjI_czMKroPVafbqJc=)** | | [CHIP IN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129391131/614181066/2078375028?refcode=ea.5fcad0bf-6437-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.5fcad0bf-6437-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZmNhZDBiZi02NDM3LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lCP0eZnZJF0zJsQ1e0enPyRXvnjI_czMKroPVafbqJc=)

Graham Platner

#
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
Contact: Michael Biundo
[michael@ascent-strategic.com](mailto:michael@ascent-strategic.com)
Date: 13-APR-2026

**New Hampshire Business and Political Leaders Endorse Lily Tang Williams**
Lily Tang Williams, Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives in New Hampshire’s 2nd district, is pleased to announce her 2026 campaign endorsements from the following prominent New Hampshire business and community leaders.

_Building on the strong foundation of support from the 64 current and former Republican New Hampshire State Legislators who endorsed her campaign last October_ , these new endorsements reflect the growing momentum behind Lily Tang Williams’ campaign as she builds the support needed to win the Republican nomination and secure victory in the general election this November.

“I am honored to receive these endorsements for my campaign. I want to thank these successful entrepreneurs and leaders for their support and trust in me to represent the Granite State in Washington DC. With this broad coalition of backing from state legislators and the business community, we are building unstoppable momentum to win the nomination and deliver a Republican victory in the general election—fighting for lower costs, stronger borders, and economic freedom for New Hampshire families.”

**Endorsing Business and Political Leaders:**
* **Al Letizio** – A.J. Letizio Sales & Marketing, Windham
* **Al Fulchino** – Fulchino Vineyard, Hollis
* **Chris Bright** – Founder of five businesses, former CD1 candidate, Derry
* **Joseph Mabe** – Hyperbaric Fitness, Swanzey
* **Wayne LeClair** – Rocky Meadow Farm, Francestown
* **James Czack** – Loudonshire Farm, Loudon

Lily Tang Williams is a survivor of Mao’s Cultural Revolution in China. Born to illiterate working-class parents in Sichuan province, she immigrated to the United States in 1988 with little money and built a successful life as an entrepreneur and real estate investor. A resident of Weare, New Hampshire, she is a devoted wife and mother, and a dedicated fighter for American liberty, free enterprise, border security, and economic opportunity.

For more information about her campaign, visit [www.lilytangwilliams.com](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=451422ee91&e=c338950e03). **Paid for by Lily4Congress Committee** ###

Peter,

At the end of this message, **[I’m going to ask you to make your first donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8634?t=8&akid=1009%2E124072%2ErJ3ki8)** But first, will you let me explain why your support – especially ahead of our mid-month deadline – is so important?
Frankly, running for Senate wasn't part of the plan. I wanted to serve North Carolina from right here at home.

Seeing all of the chaos and horrors coming out of Washington DC, I knew I had to do something. Folks had placed their trust in me throughout my career as a public servant to fight for them – and **I felt that responsibility deeply.**
This is a race I simply could not walk away from. It’s also one I know we can win.

Since launching our campaign, tens of thousands of people have joined our grassroots movement. I’m so grateful to count you as one of them, Peter.
**With a recent poll showing this race statistically tied, and far-right Republicans spending millions to defeat me, I need your help to keep up our momentum.**
**[I set a goal to raise $250,000 before our April mid-month deadline, and I’m counting on your support to reach it. Your contribution of $5 will be put to work immediately to help us win in North Carolina and take back the Senate. Will you chip in?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8639?t=9&akid=1009%2E124072%2ErJ3ki8)**

Roy Cooper

She was wrong then. She's wrong now. But she still defends every decision.

I’ll get right to the point: Republicans are doing everything they can to make it harder for eligible voters to cast their ballots. They want to make it impossible to vote with a mail-in ballot – and we can’t let that happen.
The fight over mail-in voting has landed at the steps of the U.S. Supreme Court, and with stakes this high, Americans need to GET LOUD. We have to keep momentum up if we want to win the midterm elections this November, flip the Senate, and protect one of our most fundamental rights as Americans – our ability to make our voices heard.
With our mid-month fundraising deadline looming and our voting rights under attack, we have to make up some serious ground to reach our $30,000 mid-month goal by Wednesday’s midnight deadline. **_[So I'm going to ask you straight up: Will you chip in $5 today to help Democrats take back the Senate and protect voting rights?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/53122?t=2&akid=10698%2E434096%2EraBMs2)_**
Missing this mid-month deadline would knock us off course to drum up the wave of support we need this fall. We’ve got to elect leaders who will protect our voting rights. Restricting mail-in voting would silence millions of Americans, and that’s exactly what Republicans want. So instead, let’s get loud as hell.
**_[Please, will you take a stand by giving $5 or more right now to help us defeat Trump’s enablers this upcoming November and flip the Senate for working people?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/53122?t=3&akid=10698%2E434096%2EraBMs2)_**
Thank you for all you do,
John

---
| | Peter,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

Meet Trevor Jung, Jane Aman, and Tim Hayes.

Peter, I can’t wait for you to meet our newest candidates:
**Leaders We Deserve is officially endorsing Trevor Jung for WI SD-21, Jane Aman for FL HD-37, and Tim Hayes for PA HD-143!**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260413_1_slate.lIGK3T&refcode=em20260413-3366&t=2&akid=3366%2E587540%2Ee7hTZ_)
**Trevor Jung** became the youngest person elected to the Racine Common Council in over 160 years, and spent his time there fighting to make government deliver for working people. Then the city tapped him to run their public transit system, where he modernized the fleet, launched Racine’s first transit app boosting ridership by 30%, and made bus routes better connected to hospitals, social services, and jobs for the seniors and working people that depend on them.
Trevor’s district is one of three seats Democrats need to flip to take back the Wisconsin State Senate for the first time in over 15 years. He’s spent his entire career delivering for his community, and now he’s ready to take that fighting spirit to Madison. With his history of making basic government services work better for those who need it most, Trevor is exactly the type of Democrat we need to amplify in a swing state like Wisconsin.
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260413_1_slate.lIGK3T&amount=5&refcode=em20260413-3366&t=3&akid=3366%2E587540%2Ee7hTZ_)**
**Dr. Jane Aman** bartended her way through college, earned her doctorate, and has spent her career as a dedicated educator in Central Florida. Through her students, she saw firsthand what happens when working families get left behind by their government. In Tallahassee, she’ll fight to expand Medicaid to the hundreds of thousands of Floridians still locked out of coverage, restore reproductive rights, fully fund public schools, pay teachers what they deserve, and hold greedy insurance companies accountable so Floridians aren’t left out to dry after every hurricane.
She’s running against a Republican incumbent who won her seat by less than 450 votes and has consistently sided with the extremist Florida legislature over her own constituents. This is one of the most competitive state house races in the South, and Jane is _exactly_ the candidate who has what it takes to win it.
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260413_1_slate.lIGK3T&amount=5&refcode=em20260413-3366&t=4&akid=3366%2E587540%2Ee7hTZ_)**
**Tim Hayes** made history at 21 as the youngest person elected in Bucks County and the first openly LGBTQ+ member of Dublin Borough Council. Then he helped flip the borough blue in 2023. Outside of council, Tim works at Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania, where he’s secured millions for land conservation, clean energy, sustainable farming, and has been sounding the alarm on AI data centers encroachment on local communities.
In Harrisburg, he’ll fight to build out Pennsylvania’s clean energy economy, hold corporations accountable, and make life more affordable for working families in Bucks County. Tim has already proven he can flip a district — _this one is next._
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260413_1_slate.lIGK3T&amount=5&refcode=em20260413-3366&t=5&akid=3366%2E587540%2Ee7hTZ_)**
**Not everyone who runs for office can say that they’ve actually spent the time it takes to build deep ties to their community. Trevor, Jane, and Tim have — and that’s exactly why we’re backing them.**
But these are the kind of bold progressives the corporate machine and dark money groups will come after, Peter. And the only thing that stops them is grassroots supporters like you showing up to have these leaders’ back.
**[Will you split a $5 contribution between Trevor, Jane, Tim, and Leaders We Deserve today?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260413_1_slate.lIGK3T&refcode=em20260413-3366&amount=5&t=6&akid=3366%2E587540%2Ee7hTZ_)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

Friend,

I recently came across a striking statistic.

**72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.**

And while courts often consider prior service as a factor for lighter sentences, the prosecutors and judges in these cases used their veteran or first responder status to argue for _**harsher penalties**_.

_Is this how our criminal justice system thanks them for their service?_

I’ve always honored those who serve. We are living the American dream _because_ of them. The way these patriots were treated is a grave injustice.

And while President Trump has pardoned almost all of the J6 defendants, they still haven’t received justice.

The lives and reputations of these patriots remain shattered from the lost years to the consistent government and mainstream media smear campaign they endured.

That’s why I’m proud to support Stand in the Gap.

This remarkable organization provides real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.

[If you believe in liberty, in due process, and in standing up for our fellow Americans, I hope you’ll make a donation to Stand in the Gap today. >>](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkM1qhDAQgJ8m3pT8aLJ7yKGweNtee5TZZNQUnQQT7euXLPQBehtmPj4-5us5PSFsgZZP2NG6K0xHnr61xxnJA5WcTgp5RT_H44WT5FK3vG-FqpxovHVeK9mgFcZowW_6PjSrFUJ6ePVDbwxHOaDRd-6U9E6oQQ98aIKtJt4LJe5KqKFzs3txMP3szQ0MGNbzM3komDsXKeNxQQkXBqJYp0idi3uz2bWUlJn6YHJkcszozgM7IPSxVKLuCpBvA7VlxXaBxOSYoAVXJUyNZ9knB3uCsBBTj78sJvX7EqkgFaYe7grNYX36CdsWsq6Byw5he3eU_3_usvI3AAD__xwhfFA)

Before January 6th, many of these patriots were unaware of just how broken the American justice system truly was.
Even after being pardoned, many J6 defendants still face...
* Difficulties finding a job
* Loss of rights, like the right to vote or the right to own a firearm
* Harassment on social media and in their personal lives
* Strained family relationships due to lost time in prison
* And even homelessness.

For many, returning to some semblance of a normal life is overwhelming.

**Stand in the Gap is committed to being a comprehensive support system for J6 defendants and their families by providing essential resources to help these American patriots heal physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually.**

Stand in the Gap believes in second chances, providing support to individuals transitioning back into society after incarceration, and working towards a more forward-thinking and restorative prison system that sends non-violent offenders into the world better off than they were when they went in.

Through their programs, partnerships, and advocacy efforts, they are making a lasting impact on the lives of those in need.

**There are nearly 1,600 Americans who are looking for a second chance.**

Let’s show these patriots they’re not forgotten.

If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **

_But now, Patriot, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

By Mark Vargas, Editor-in-Chief & Scott Kaspar, Publisher

The evidence is mounting. The warnings are growing louder. And yet, Illinois Republicans in Springfield remain silent.

At what point does silence become complicity?

Concerns about waste, fraud, and abuse under Governor JB Pritzker are no longer whispers – and they are being raised by national figures, media voices, and independent investigators. The call for a federal probe is growing stronger by the day.

But not in Springfield.

Illinois Review has reported extensively on troubling patterns in state spending and contracts. More than $20 billion in taxpayer-funded contracts have flowed to businesses tied to Governor JB Pritzker’s so-called “blind” trust. Over $180 million has been directed toward projects benefiting the governor’s hotel interests, raising serious questions about priorities and oversight.

And roughly $2.5 billion in taxpayer dollars has been spent to provide free healthcare to illegal immigrants – individuals who, by definition, broke the law to enter the country.

These are not small numbers. These are staggering figures that demand scrutiny.

Longtime Trump advisor Roger Stone has warned that Pritzker “is in trouble” as calls grow for an FBI investigation – comments that reached nearly 750,000 people and generated over 22,500 reactions in just one day.

https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2026/04/every-republican-in-springfield-should-resign-for-refusing-to-demand-fbi-probe-into-pritzker-and-state-finances.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0d1f60ba5a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823#google_vignette
Republican gubernatorial candidate Darren Bailey has also sounded the alarm, pointing to what he describes as “immense” fraud tied to state finances and urging federal authorities to step in.

Even the White House is paying attention. Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt confirmed the President is aware of concerns surrounding waste, fraud, and abuse in Illinois.

And now, independent journalist Nick Shirley – whose reporting helped expose massive fraud in Minnesota – is eyeing Illinois next.

Everyone sees it. Everyone is talking about it. Except Illinois Republicans who represent the people in Springfield.

https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2026/04/every-republican-in-springfield-should-resign-for-refusing-to-demand-fbi-probe-into-pritzker-and-state-finances.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0d1f60ba5a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823#google_vignette
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2026/04/every-republican-in-springfield-should-resign-for-refusing-to-demand-fbi-probe-into-pritzker-and-state-finances.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0d1f60ba5a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823#google_vignette
And the reason why is as troubling as the silence itself.

Inside the Illinois House, many Republican legislators are afraid – not of the truth, but of their own leadership. Specifically, they fear crossing House Minority Leader Tony McCombie and losing the perks that come with their positions.

A salary of more than $100,000 a year for a part-time job. Taxpayer-funded office space. Staff. And special low digit license plates that show the world how special you are.

Speak out – and risk losing it all. So instead of standing up for taxpayers, they stay quiet.

Even members of the Illinois House Freedom Caucus – who brand themselves as the true conservative fighters in Springfield – have failed to call for a federal investigation into what could be one of the largest financial scandals in state history.

They have shown they can act boldly when they choose to. In September 2025, the Illinois House Freedom Caucus filed articles of impeachment against Gov. Pritzker (HR 466), accusing him of inciting violence through inflammatory anti-Republican rhetoric. They held press conferences, generated headlines, and took a strong public stand.

Yet on the far more consequential issue of potential waste, fraud, and abuse in state finances — the very dollars funding Pritzker’s expansive agenda — they have remained silent. No resolution demanding an FBI or DOJ investigation. No call for a forensic audit of bloated contracts, Medicaid spending, or questionable state grants.

They fight hard on rhetoric and taxes. But when it comes to following the money — the one path that could expose systemic corruption — the fighters go missing.

This is not leadership. This is self-preservation.

Meanwhile, Illinois families are paying the price. Property taxes remain among the highest in the nation. Schools continue to fail too many children despite record spending. Crime persists. And taxpayers are left asking where their money is going.

They deserve answers. They deserve accountability. And they deserve leaders with the courage to demand both.

If Illinois Republicans are too afraid to call for an FBI investigation into Pritzker and the state’s finances, then they are not doing their jobs.

And if they are not doing their jobs, they should resign. Every single one of them.

Because until corruption is confronted, nothing else matters.

Illinois Review is the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source in Illinois that has been shared by President Donald Trump. X () Facebook () IllinoisReview.com () Every Republican in Springfield Should Resign for Refusing to Demand FBI Probe Into Pritzker and State Finances () (Erin Hooley/AP Photos) By Mark Vargas, Editor-in-Chief & Scott Kaspar, Publisher The evidence is mounting. The warnings are growing louder. And yet, Illinois Republicans in Springfield remain silent. At what point does silence become complicity? Concerns about waste, fraud, and abuse under Governor JB Pritzker are no longer whispers – and they are being raised by national figures, media voices, and independent investigators. The call for a federal probe is growing stronger by the day. But not in Springfield. Illinois Review has reported extensively on troubling patterns in state spending and contracts. More than $20 billion in taxpayer-funded contracts have flowed to businesses tied to Governor JB Pritzker’s so-called “blind” trust. Over $180 million has been directed toward projects benefiting the governor’s hotel interests, raising serious questions about priorities and oversight. And roughly $2.5 billion in taxpayer dollars has been spent to provide free healthcare to illegal immigrants – individuals who, by definition, broke the law to enter the country. These are not small numbers. These are staggering figures that demand scrutiny. Longtime Trump advisor Roger Stone has warned that Pritzker “is in trouble” as calls grow for an FBI investigation – comments that reached nearly 750,000 people and generated over 22,500 reactions in just one day. Republican gubernatorial candidate Darren Bailey has also sounded the alarm, pointing to what he describes as “immense” fraud tied to state finances and urging federal authorities to step in. Even the White House is paying attention. Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt confirmed the President is aware of concerns surrounding waste, fraud, and abuse in Illinois. And now, independent journalist Nick Shirley – whose reporting helped expose massive fraud in Minnesota – is eyeing Illinois next. Everyone sees it. Everyone is talking about it. Except Illinois Republicans who represent the people in Springfield. And the reason why is as troubling as the silence itself. Inside the Illinois House, many Republican legislators are afraid – not of the truth, but of their own leadership. Specifically, they fear crossing House Minority Leader Tony McCombie and losing the perks that come with their positions. A salary of more than $100,000 a year for a part-time job. Taxpayer-funded office space. Staff. And special low digit license plates that show the world how special you are. Speak out – and risk losing it all. So instead of standing up for taxpayers, they stay quiet. Even members of the Illinois House Freedom Caucus – who brand themselves as the true conservative fighters in Springfield – have failed to call for a federal investigation into what could be one of the largest financial scandals in state history. They have shown they can act boldly when they choose to. In September 2025, the Illinois House Freedom Caucus filed articles of impeachment against Gov. Pritzker (HR 466), accusing him of inciting violence through inflammatory anti-Republican rhetoric. They held press conferences, generated headlines, and took a strong public stand. Yet on the far more consequential issue of potential waste, fraud, and abuse in state finances — the very dollars funding Pritzker’s expansive agenda — they have remained silent. No resolution demanding an FBI or DOJ investigation. No call for a forensic audit of bloated contracts, Medicaid spending, or questionable state grants. They fight hard on rhetoric and taxes. But when it comes to following the money — the one path that could expose systemic corruption — the fighters go missing. This is not leadership. This is self-preservation. Meanwhile, Illinois families are paying the price. Property taxes remain among the highest in the nation. Schools continue to fail too many children despite record spending. Crime persists. And taxpayers are left asking where their money is going. They deserve answers. They deserve accountability. And they deserve leaders with the courage to demand both. If Illinois Republicans are too afraid to call for an FBI investigation into Pritzker and the state’s finances, then they are not doing their jobs. And if they are not doing their jobs, they should resign. Every single one of them. Because until corruption is confronted, nothing else matters. Illinois remains broken. * Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

| | | | | | Friends,
Brad is a Christian, conservative businessman who leads with courage and integrity.

While other candidates in this race are busy slinging mud, Brad is cutting through the noise with a positive message and a clear blueprint for Georgia’s future.
Last week, Brad launched his [**first ad**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=79b2acbad6&e=6036811227) , "My Faith," which highlights how Brad’s trust in Jesus Christ has guided him through every chapter of his life.
He isn't just talking about the challenges facing Georgia. Brad is focused on delivering real results to make Georgia safer, stronger, and more affordable for every hardworking family.
Brad’s steady, conservative leadership is exactly what we need in the Governor’s office. There’s no doubt he will stand for Georgia—no matter what.
– Team Raff
---
[|
---](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=5d7389d9ae&e=6036811227)
| | Brad shares how his Christian faith has been the steady foundation for his life as a husband, father, and businessman.
He opens up about how his convictions gave him hope during his family’s darkest hour following the loss of their son, Brenton, to fentanyl.
While other politicians focus on noise and negativity, Brad remains guided by his faith to make Georgia a safer, stronger, and more affordable place to live.
---
[|
---](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=baec8f5534&e=6036811227)

_My Christian faith doesn’t always give me answers,__But it always gives me great hope.__I’m Brad Raffensperger.__Faith inspired me to be the best husband and father I could be.__It guided us as we started businesses and created hundreds of great jobs.__And it sustained us when fentanyl took our son Brenton.__My faith will always guide me as your next governor.__To make Georgia a safer, stronger, more affordable place to live._
---
|

| | **AJC Politically Georgia: Raff’s Path**
Last week, the Atlanta Journal-Constitution featured Brad’s new ad and memo outlining Brad’s path to victory in the race.
_“While Lt. Gov. Burt Jones and health care executive Rick Jackson have been pummeling each other on the airwaves, Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger is betting the slugfest gives him an opening in the GOP race for governor._
_“That’s the core message of a_[ _new campaign memo_](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=de2e801b68&e=6036811227) _from the secretary of state’s team, which argues the increasingly expensive feud between the two could help Raffensperger slip into a runoff.”_
Read the entire article [HERE](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=87d2a7090b&e=6036811227).
---
|
---
| | **Georgia Recorder: Top Georgia candidates competing in 2026 midterms set to debate later this month**
Mark your calendars. Brad will be taking the stage with other candidates on April 27th. Voters will get a first hand look at the only candidate in the field with a plan for Georgia’s future.
_“The May 19 primary election, when Georgians will select party nominees for races up and down the ballot, is a month and a half away, and voters will soon have the chance to meet some of the candidates on their screens._
_“The Atlanta Press Club Loudermilk-Young Debate Series is set to host primary election debates for top races between Sunday, April 26 and Tuesday, April 28. Separate debates will be held between members of both major parties. Those who win next month’s party primaries will go on to compete in the Nov. 3 general election.”_
Read the entire article [HERE](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=3bb3b9338b&e=6036811227).
---
|
---
| | **AJC: Politically Georgia
** In an AJC exclusive, Brad’s new ad underscores his Christian faith as a guiding light in his decision making.
_"Raffensperger_[ _launched his first television ad_](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=7ab9a870ef&e=6036811227) _of the campaign, a multi-million-dollar statewide buy that leans on his biography rather than the attack-heavy messaging dominating the GOP contest._
_“In the 30-second spot, Raffensperger says his Christian faith has guided him through every chapter of his life and helped sustain him through the loss of his son, Brenton, to a fentanyl overdose.”_
Read the entire article [HERE](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=3a9f6c359b&e=6036811227).
---
|
---
| | **WSB: Dozens of victims in alleged Georgia Ponzi scheme to get money back after settlement**
Brad continues to fight for the innocent people of Georgia who were taken advantage of in the alleged First Liberty banking Ponzi scheme.
_“Dozens of victims of an alleged Georgia-based Ponzi scheme are set to recover their money following a $6.7 million settlement._
_"Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger says 46 people who lost money after investing with_[ _**First Liberty Building and Loan**_](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=59223e82d4&e=6036811227 "https://www.wsbradio.com/news/crime-and-law/georgia-co-founder-fined-500k-first-liberty-ponzi-scheme/AN2UXIIIOJHFFCWZWKUSDK3POY/") _will have their funds returned._
_“He says financial services firm Bankers Life has agreed to pay back the $6.7 million it received from those investors through the alleged scheme.”_
Read the entire article [HERE](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=a36a005f35&e=6036811227).

name: Jim Jordan
subject: I’ll never accuse you of abandoning us
body:
Insulting...
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Peter!

| Peter,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
---
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
---
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
---
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
---
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
---
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
---
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._
---
That’s how we won in 2024. And it’s my plan to win AGAIN in 2026.
---

## Farmer Turns Down $26M for Her Land
An 82-year-old Kentucky farmer [rejected a $26 million offer](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO4yAUBODT2B0WDzA4BcU26bLtlhbCj4QEQwQvQb79yv8V_n40o2_-3dabiynm-1-3ow33sFIoa8beEhJhXYOrO9aKT_TU9phSLLmha7QKLjTjioFcNxfTsc7jZgOiQDmiBWM0AMxCjg_rF9i0u4QLaL941EZ50EahdsbMfr6M0Z5tXIEUHBYlJlgAvNJcSOWkx2VQHLdIpU7PEjM9MKSjfLFOvuxjsg-idxvkn0FcB3HtvU8noSO-zsAgri_M9PGvgwW3x3Qw-tTc2FZ6ZkLvLJTKXGSbI8c8ZsLKAIzUgs9jtdu7n_CmzaD4fXcx_czSr__6WvE_AAD__zU0gMc) from an unnamed artificial intelligence (AI) company that wanted to convert part of her family's 1,200-acre property into an AI data center campus. Ida Huddleston's family has farmed the land in Mason County for generations, including growing wheat during the Great Depression to help keep bread lines running. Her daughter, Delsia Bare, summed up [the family's position](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L9uwyAQBvCnwZstOPC_gaGLt3TtiCg-YhJsInwJ8ttXbvMGHU86fZ9-39fFXGyIYbt-2hW1v3pDPpkNyx6RCLPxNq-YM97Q0b6GGEPadrQ7GeDQ1VzVQprZhniYtpq1RwSUFWrR950QogVZLRrcCO5beeDtODqcsbWyFwPH0fqul6IK-kzjSkjgYlDQiEEIpzoOUlnpcGCK4xwo5eaWwkYL-nikF-bGpbWKeiF67Ex-MJgYTKWU5vkoKdNynA8Mpjtu9HT3o_7z1G9QDV39RjGYqqznRznPveuZ4tfVhvjbQP-e5qXhJwAA__9nn3p-): "_Stay and hold and feed a nation. $26 million doesn't mean anything._ " The unnamed company offered roughly [$60,000 per acre](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkb-upDwMxZ8GOo_yBxi-guJrprvbbol8EwO54yQo8XDFPv2K0e4TbHMk29Kxz88_P-YPDBzS-gMjTcu6zLLkOdF3ZRKhMi9YIpVCX-SkxsAccqqEVWajzACqA21nj4HPuW_9tBAZsi1N-n4ftNa9se02Db0bu8Faqz6Vp35ArfuBRqd7tYz_-bEN0-WmOm2N0mNnbnrU2nWDMrZD62hsOkU-SC63rxySbLTwmQ8qN5djy9MmstfG_t-YR2MenB2yNtesMY8rzN_mVeYiG5UET0rycs8TFoyBT_DkOCSqYAb4ExQ-gwePguAoCRXYGVMF9AcmRxDxrEdgJsAAQm57S8qc1xNcTlXKy8nlc1F8C2PysJe8U5FrJTLsr-I2rASVmGHNeWWCSIKAEX_lBBFrTuDyK8kJEcuTBA7kF4ELyYWUUEJbJr9_X1fX4d50ao0Y-A1H_vmrx2R-BwAA__-Ru8Ds), about 10 times the going rate, for a planned 2,000-acre facility. A local group has filed a lawsuit challenging the rezoning. "_What I've got here, I want to pass it down_ ," Ida told a local news station. "_What God told me to do was to keep it until I was through with it and then pass it on to the next generation_."
## School Learns Sign Language for Deaf Student
Seven-year-old Ben O'Reilly is deaf and the [only deaf student in his school district](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAUhJ_G7rDgQGxvQbGNu2y7JToLB5uInwhIrLz9yvc-wq1mpJFGM9_fu7ljiCHvfzCR9rs33ReT6WyReqdqPNZEtdKDbG8pxBhKboStG-AwM66YkMZhiB9zG532REByJC2WZRZC3ECOh0aFAiU4cePk3S-_LnL24NUiZrCcYAz6auNKSOBiVTCJVQirZg5SobS0DoqTC73U6VFC7gf5-ClvqpMtaYz66P3ZBvl7gG2A7TzPyf5r14srH2C77LewA9OzHaESa_YoJbIW9swi5v2FOzFbUnrlYLETc4Setf5ylPsA21i1e54XgjYvg-J7whC_BvQfk3tr-B8AAP__FYaGMA) in Campton, New Hampshire, a state without a dedicated school for the deaf. His aide said Ben felt isolated and "very alone" at school, with virtually no one he could communicate with. That changed when [classmates started](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDuO2zAURVcjdTTEJ1qWCxZp1E3alMKzeClxws-AfLHh3QcKkBVMdYsLHBycXx_rB4cY8v6TE6zf_Sq-rBmvFiGCunquCbXiE5u0FGIMJTdwk5UGmtRglB5XxyG-12vvrAcIYw-rb7dJa32lsT8sPeZ5fODhZmxM7u7oesXdQ0-e7phMH-xJG4weadCzoYuetd7MNNBoeNwwd2aAC1Lq5bOELAd8fJcn6mUrqY_2EPlq3fijo6Wj5ZVSu4QDXOX8O1q2kgVZOlr-Ww-TQpZQoRCRkIXrW7XtKCWqCK65qRb2rCLn_Q_vUFKUcPx9rgN75UNtovbKDrWjpa_Wfb3OPm26dWbYE4f4z06-nfVp6W8AAAD__2Yyj3k) picking up a few signs, then decided to learn sign language together. Eventually, teachers across the school joined in, using sign language even when Ben wasn't around. Today, nearly every student and staff member at Campton Elementary knows at least some sign language. Ben's adoptive parents were overwhelmed by the effort. "I could barely breathe," his mom told CBS News. His aide said the difference has been remarkable: "_You could just watch his world open up with communication_." [Watch the video](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0E1qwzAUBODTyLsY_dlOFloUiguFFEoXXYpn-SlWkKwgvcSkpy_uFbqdgQ9mvs_2DCGG9fIBCY2_eEs-2xW3GpEIi_VQEpaCV3RUU4gx5LUiVLKSy_7A9UEoO0OIT9s1s_GIElWDRgxDL4TopGoWAxOC0xM_6Z7PWnWI-iRd1znwfBIwNMHsGtdCSS6OWrbiKITTPZdKg3J4ZJrjHCiX9prDSgv6-MwPLK3LqYlmIbpVpl6YHJkct21rn_lO9wn3fk-A3MLU-GDqNR3elP05f72Pn00x823bR9V-YJpfEoT4R9K_v3gY-RsAAP__Jpx0Hg).
## Bald Eagles Hatch Easter Chicks
Bald eagle pair Jackie and Shadow [welcomed their second chick](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQRp_G7iZiAP8VFNuku9tuaU1gsEmwsQDFytuvnFe49Sd9Ouf8-5l_KMSwL39pY-MXP1ef5p3PErlWzrOnvHHO_GRbyxZiDGkvTKXOUsgehAZUs6MQP3PXOuOZJauWDQ5Dj4idVO1qxm4YJGpCZOy9t53jxzBZniY_UMeyDeZ6ExqVFDhqecMR0epeSKVJWR4bLdiFmvLtmcJeV_bxk96cbzZtbTRrrUdp1J9G3ht5Pzgdka-pkfcHRQdMS2Q4KGR4kn0FBtodlJVcOuHkaNPGUNim3YFdg31B2uGy5AyOPvB1RZy06gS22bjjvFKUfmi0WDYK8QtSf13wbeT_AAAA__9jQIaj) on Easter Day in Big Bear Valley, California, the day after their first eaglet hatched. Both chicks are healthy and feeding, according to [Friends of Big Bear Valley](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OwyAQR_HT2F2sYSD-KCi2cZdtt0QT-49DhE0EKFFuv8peYS_wk977ubiLhBiO7Vt2WL95V31yB14lolZk5yXvyBl3LLXsIcaQjgIp1TFxfyJzUtqtEuLbndvVeoChW1g1DL1S6sy6vdlJsT9PmpiYSEY1DXSF0SIaw0RY2mA_GhmlmdRouFOjUovpibURvWBsDGENNeXunsJRb_DxnZ7I3ZL2NtpbrY_S6K-G54ZnnwOOtSR_DdsVkp8SI95dylvDM2SLOJWackBpeG6zXR-vT1jph8bQtkuIf2z994-n5d8AAAD__6oodh0), which livestreams the nest to more than 1.2 million Facebook followers and is among the most-watched wildlife cams in the country. The chicks, nicknamed "bobbleheads" at this stage, are just beginning to feed. The hatchings come after the pair [lost an earlier set of eggs](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2SpSAQx0-DGa-gQdSAYBOy2XRDq8VWeYMyBexY3n6LvcIk3R10_T9-fz7mDwwxXPtvPMlu-zbXLc0X3SVSrZTnDfNJOdObfC1niDGkqxCWOoMAw4XmUs0rhvjMfbfajQhIdWTlMBgpZQ-qO6ySotfGLzAOepMrTkbDNJEc-qVXBscu2KYmtFQg5KjhJUcpvTYClEblaWRa0Bpqyq93Clc9aItP-qb88unsoj1q_SpM_WLgGLj7vl9_C9a04tMeGLhSU34YuNasLawhXQxcs2XghG6jXUvY-UKYOeEeqXCPJ3-j_wzEy4Frurk_gv8s_MDqDwZunPQohVFCDAxcl-36dTdMxQxMi_3EEP-HrD-m-23hXwAAAP__oUWMZQ) this season. The happy news also arrives as a $10 million fundraising deadline looms to protect the eagles' habitat. A 63-acre stretch of lakefront less than a mile from the nest is slated for a housing development and marina, and conservationists warn the construction could drive the pair from the area. The group hopes to purchase and permanently protect the land before the July 31 deadline.

# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2069%2E5691347%2EgD0Egr)

Peter, it’s Jon.
I need you to know how important you are to this campaign.
When I think about my supporters who have made the biggest difference, I don’t think about the amount they’ve given.
I think about the people who were there when I needed them most. So far, more than a million people have contributed to my Senate campaigns. That is absolutely incredible, and it’s something I will _never_ take for granted.
But we’re getting into crunch time, Peter. The President was in Georgia in February. JD Vance is coming tomorrow. Before you know it, the GOP primary will be over and they’ll turn all their attention (and Super PAC $$$) on me.
**I am literally MAGA’s #1 target.**
So I’m asking for your help one more time today. To make sure we’re ready for whatever comes next.
**Peter, I wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t so important:[Can you please make your first online contribution to my reelection campaign?](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-april26.1MDdBw&refcode=em260413-3-subs&t=2&akid=2069%2E5691347%2EgD0Egr)**
Thank you for chipping in if you can afford it. I am so grateful for your support.
Jon

My fellow Americans - this is your Vice President.
[I hope this email finds you well. Admittedly, it’s a bit longer than my typical message to you, but I’m betting it’ll be worth your time if you can spare a minute or two.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=b85a6056e34c40e99298b85826eee1d2&_e=XBpY2BdJA9vs3X5-Y2v56S85iGJ3w-5-jfmEz5dNfy-UuwPWAUjADQqalEr3GRfblbZk-7_Vr_O_sd2SErUik1HlmN-_6j4xJqsIyCaV7d92_SLJkK7w0HbOuVQwrVU_yNfvwp4RekPRWx0ou6xdSQsz0qtEG3YTQ2vFQrxl2l6u4tkg3Y1dF0zHJjcBvCX841UgnO0MkxEZSZDzYofDm4jEZp97x2lOwv4pLXFGiwvvJmXJcHqoShxxp_Qqxhz6do6Jfwl2wxXnH40HvnKea6WYwVTQPhAjSS3sHqeN7ANJNyeplSTgRLmCYASKMOWCj3GMuREan9AJo0kHec82yU5FcdFAPZrzKDtDD3zeO-oaGu_zWY0b9tNYxabaJduhTfXRqVRHBXhPzF0NZiPuTnZ2uE_xfetAWBm7uldzqup1sGmmCf7CMha5PbeKm1WP05v3JsWRiagaBGSoF7yWdm9HFIbzrYMoPGWLpzef8P9O4uz6Uk7ibsg5IOocttKE5xFppmWUa9smaFSaNb-B44ijjnbhjsV6d8e1AnBqjT1CY4fPxJEOtDyNZ-OlrVCP3wfi60LH4ncM2PYOpj8m1c40dlytXQ8cjUkRTZM1pLu4B0hv_lIBHHjUr3ww3VzdE1XFU2RvAf-POJgNkZ3AashzU2otLRCsVSHjktbc6VbfDqLj7RDE0S7bxHAMtGCyusQMl63uMp2jqhzFj8q4YCn86Ko8NxDA2-CrqkvKo-SZfHN34lCw5LalFX6nqkdn8F91pcL4DT8V8E_Q-8jrDQC19Yd9IPYYWLwBU0qu0IW6HaI8MBwnEHxZx9GGcpLVN4u-2IaMR6tVJB3lrOiuzPoLbKymidVI1K1NGWDvqdJku58tM5deCGa_5CBc8TJzBdIy6andXLCgp9nQIE4s0A%3D%3D)
Where else on the planet can a big-city real estate guy and a small-town hillbilly team up to bring down a political machine to become the leader of the free world and his right hand?
The answer is nowhere but the Shining City on a Hill.
But just like President Reagan, I believe in my heart of hearts that freedom is always a generation away from extinction.
So while I'll never forget Election Night 2024, my sights are set squarely on Election Night 2026.
That's because EVERYTHING comes down to the midterm elections. If the Democrats win back control of Congress, everything we've worked so hard for comes to a SCREECHING HALT!
That's why the Democrat Machine is mobilizing earlier, faster, and more powerfully than anyone thought possible. And we're in for a shellacking if we don't get our act together. Why? Because the Democrats are...
- Unleashing swarms of attack ads in every swing district - just like 2024- Plastering the media with anti-Trump propaganda - just like all last year- Weaponizing the Deep State to undermine us - just par for the course- Suing us in court to hamstring our agenda - just like Joe Biden did- Tracking to rake in a billion (with a "b") dollars - just like Kamala Harris
They're throwing the kitchen sink at us because everyone knows they can't win on the issues. The American People rejected their agenda of open borders, hostility toward cops, divisive DEI programming, transgender activism, and hating the freest country on Earth.
It's a losing message. I know it. You know it. And they know it too.
That's why the Democrats resort to the ugly, gutter-level politics that pits Americans against each other. They divide so they can conquer.
And the only way they win is if too many Conservatives in our movement rest on our laurels.
The so-called "experts" say that the Democrat Party is fired up and MAGA will sit out this election without Donald Trump on the ballot.
I say they're full of it (as usual).
I believe in this movement. Even though it's early, I have faith that Conservatives who really get it will rise to the challenge and stand with us. The folks who remember when the Democrats impeached our President, kicked him off the ballot, and indicted him in court WILL step up when we need them the most.
I'm hoping you fit that bill.
[That’s why I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise for the FINAL TIME this month to ask for your help in our greatest hour of need.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=b85a6056e34c40e99298b85826eee1d2&_e=XBpY2BdJA9vs3X5-Y2v56S85iGJ3w-5-jfmEz5dNfy-UuwPWAUjADQqalEr3GRfblbZk-7_Vr_O_sd2SErUik1HlmN-_6j4xJqsIyCaV7d92_SLJkK7w0HbOuVQwrVU_yNfvwp4RekPRWx0ou6xdSQsz0qtEG3YTQ2vFQrxl2l6u4tkg3Y1dF0zHJjcBvCX841UgnO0MkxEZSZDzYofDm4jEZp97x2lOwv4pLXFGiwvvJmXJcHqoShxxp_Qqxhz6do6Jfwl2wxXnH40HvnKea6WYwVTQPhAjSS3sHqeN7ANJNyeplSTgRLmCYASKMOWCj3GMuREan9AJo0kHec82yT9fqFW3YKaSppSORb5UzT5fX_L9_SO2I5jhdm3nvBBo7tBMeC3Kv5L2Xj_KLlMSviceE1_lrAAAXlpEW0sxaEbxSPjHaIJ7Zo-3h-m6wpBKRUp6anjgCMr2h8wuOT6GMdMkb7FTXBAdS3s0i6xrWE9ex-Gm2Ztddj1QPPPpiuW8alBYv4SN5IgRw26AI0ghZs4f52ELePH9nkP9XVscdrGJNOTq2Auag_LUi_txzsjXYLqyvIky3HgGDKVZJg04_jhF5uFXfx_QW4nhOm3KpQVxyTZ2mWHxlXQMJNsX4veXJXqvqbJ1PQMMzO5lp-x85xCNmPgCT9862cMtZYJ-AtlDCA_X2dCmMCzprMvb4A6u4oCvVioF2akvtzd3mUZUeXDDvC93ZbCwJKkuJAU_C84hPJb5-fnB2LiZThb8Lv6tYd1_qv6CWqG6uJxhvUdicMSp0A1IkM2RzIy7x9bJ95ip9W4MQGazvqQpTneEbFccam7s0Fz-ymFNEKYRMBo4rZToFIznRy4s22F--vf1i_rCWgHIY2QVTgNXL_oKLmaWFxyDqd8P8oFpv5BfI64rxw%3D%3D)

Do you think you can help us get there?
Whether it's $5 or $500 - the amount you give isn't nearly as important as how many folks step up:

The answer is nowhere but the Shining City on a Hill. But just like President Reagan, I believe in my heart of hearts that freedom is always a generation away from extinction. So while I'll never forget Election Night 2024, my sights are set squarely on Election Night 2026. That's because EVERYTHING comes down to the midterm elections. If the Democrats win back control of Congress, everything we've worked so hard for comes to a SCREECHING HALT! That's why the Democrat Machine is mobilizing earlier, faster, and more powerfully than anyone thought possible. And we're in for a shellacking if we don't get our act together. Why? The American People rejected their agenda of open borders, hostility toward cops, divisive DEI programming, transgender activism, and hating the freest country on Earth. It's a losing message. I know it. You know it. And they know it too. That's why the Democrats resort to the ugly, gutter-level politics that pits Americans against each other. They divide so they can conquer. And the only way they win is if too many Conservatives in our movement rest on our laurels. The so-called "experts" say that the Democrat Party is fired up and MAGA will sit out this election without Donald Trump on the ballot. I say they're full of it (as usual). I believe in this movement. Even though it's early, I have faith that Conservatives who really get it will rise to the challenge and stand with us. The folks who remember when the Democrats impeached our President, kicked him off the ballot, and indicted him in court WILL step up when we need them the most. I'm hoping you fit that bill. We set a goal of raising one million bucks this month from every zip code in America. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Justice Democrats
body:
I’m running to give San Francisco a leader who is beholden to the people, not corporate PACs or lobbyists.
#
Peter,
This is Saikat Chakrabarti: Bernie Sanders 2016 campaign alum, cofounder of Justice Democrats, former chief of staff to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and current candidate for Congress in CA-11.
Years ago, I never imagined that I would help start a progressive organization dedicated to transforming the Democratic Party through competitive primaries and truly people-powered candidates — and then would later be endorsed by that same organization when running for former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi’s seat.
**I’m so incredibly proud to be part of the Justice Democrats’ 2026 primary slate.** It was surreal to receive the news with my brother, former Justice Democrats Rep. Jamaal Bowman, by my side. As I told him, this all feels like a homecoming. It is truly a full-circle moment.
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260413.mr9VDX&refcode=em20260413-37663&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=37663%2E1203867%2EniCR3X)
It’s amazing to see the thing that we created to try to change power come this far in just a few short years. Justice Democrats started out by backing leaders like Cori Bush, recruiting and electing AOC in 2018, and went on to send the Squad to the halls of power, taking the Democratic establishment by surprise again and again.
Since then, JD has led the fight to reject AIPAC from the Democratic Party, recentered the focus on working people, and built the bloc up to 10 progressive champions in Congress. But if we’re going to win Medicare for All and the Green New Deal, abolish ICE, end U.S. complicity in Israel’s genocide, and lift up our working communities across the country, _we need to elect even more._
That’s why I’m honored to be one of 15 primary candidates backed by JD this cycle. If we want to change the system, it’s got to be a group of us — it can’t just be any one of us. **It’s got to be a movement of candidates working with a movement of people.**
Our country is in crisis, and in San Francisco, families are being pushed out by rising costs and a corrupt political system. We don’t need more corporate Democrats protecting the status quo in Washington. We need a Party that fights for its voters, not tech oligarchs and corporations.
Meanwhile, **my opponent will do anything to win this seat, including lie and take money from crypto and tech billionaires.** Silicon Valley and the Democratic establishment are already spending millions and sending attack mailers against me, because they know we can win.
With this House seat controlled by the Democratic establishment for nearly 40 years, this primary is our chance to start something new and give San Francisco a progressive representative beholden to them, _not corporate PACs or lobbyists._
**[Let’s say no to the status quo and completely change the direction of the Democratic Party this year: will you help us win this primary on June 2nd by making a grassroots contribution today?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260413.mr9VDX&refcode=em20260413-37663&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=3&akid=37663%2E1203867%2EniCR3X)**
**[Contribute $5](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260413.mr9VDX&refcode=em20260413-37663&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=22&akid=37663%2E1203867%2EniCR3X)**
I’m honored to be part of a growing movement for a new generation of leaders ready to meet this moment and deliver solutions that match the scale of the challenges we face. This is our New Deal moment.
In solidarity,
Saikat

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20260413-37663-footer&t=23&refcode2=37663_1203867_niCR3X&akid=37663%2E1203867%2EniCR3X)**

| Friend, NH Senate Republicans and NH House Republicans are fighting to **end reckless local spending sprees and bring property tax relief to the Granite State**. Read the latest Op-Ed from Senate Majority Leader Regina Birdsell and House Majority Leader Jason Osborne below 👇 and [consider making a contribution to our 2026 campaign fund here!](https://click.mlsend2.com/link/c/YT0yOTg2NjQzNDkxNDY0OTQzMzIzJmM9YzRyMCZlPTE5MjgmYj0xNTMzNDc4NjQ4JmQ9bzVjOWQ5bQ==.TUN69X_P05dRSN_5CAAC2iK8gnXSxKSaNEkGPIDmFD8) Thank you, NH Senate Republicans

| You already know the feeling. You open your property tax bill, and the number is higher than last year’s. Again. You cut back on your own spending. You make trade-offs every month to stay on budget. And then your local government asks you to pay more, with no explanation that makes any sense. You are not imagining it. Over the past four years, local government spending in New Hampshire has surged from $4.76 billion to $6.0 billion. That is a 28 percent increase. Your local tax bill went up because your local officials voted to spend more of your money. Over that same period, student enrollment kept falling. New Hampshire schools have lost nearly 40,000 students since the peak two decades ago, dropping from 208,461 to roughly 168,900. Even with fewer kids in the classroom, the budget keeps growing. You are paying more for less, and nobody at town hall or on the school board seems to think that is a problem. Democrats will tell you the state is to blame. They have spent years pushing a theory they call “down-shifting,” the idea that when the state does not spend enough, local taxes go up. They use this argument to make the case for a statewide income tax. Here is why that argument is dead. Over the past six years, New Hampshire Republicans have delivered more state funding to towns and schools than any legislature in state history. We increased total education aid from $599 million to more than $950 million, a 52 percent increase. That’s over 2.1 billion in state education funding for local schools in this 2-year state budget. Per-pupil funding climbed from $5,900 to over $7,100. In the FY22-23 budget, Republicans pushed $200 million into the statewide education property tax, sending relief directly to local taxpayers. Combined with meals and rooms distributions, total state support to municipalities has grown 74 percent, outpacing inflation by 29 points. The state sent more money than ever. Your property taxes still went up 20 percent. If “down-shifting” were real, that would be impossible. The truth is simpler, yet harder to accept: your local government got a record check from Concord and spent even more on top of it. And here is the part that should make you angry. The budgets that set your property tax rate are approved at local elections, where less than 20 percent of voters show up. Compare that to 70 percent, or more, in a general election. The spending decisions that hit your wallet the hardest are made by the smallest number of people, at meetings most taxpayers do not even know are happening. That is why Republicans are promising you a real option with HB 1300, the Property Tax Protection Act. This bill puts a tax cap question on the general election ballot every two years. You would decide whether school budgets can grow beyond the prior year’s level adjusted for inflation and new construction. Bonded capital projects are excluded. If voters approve the cap, budgets stay disciplined. If voters choose to override it, spending goes up with the full consent of the electorate. No more budget increases decided by a handful of insiders late on a Tuesday night in an empty auditorium in March. At the state level, we have grown the economy, doubled revenues, and balanced the budget. We delivered tax relief to the employers who create jobs, to retirees living on fixed incomes, and to you every time you go out to eat. We sent record funding to your towns and schools, and your property taxes still went up. Now, with HB 1300, we are going to put a tool on your ballot to finally rein in out-of-control local spending, without sacrificing an ounce of local control.

name: AOC
subject: It's time to know your neighbor.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Believe it or not, building community — whether it's your church, mosque, a knitting group, your dinner circle — is far more transformative than you realize.
If you don’t know your neighbor, it’s time to know your neighbor.
If you have a co-worker you think you’re cool with, it’s time to get to know that person.
It’s time to get to know the people we will be relying on to protect each other.
It may seem frivolous, but I guarantee you it’s not: **creating community around you is one of the most powerful and radical things you can do in an environment like this**.
Sometimes even just being in community with people who are not like-minded with you — is a very odd little thing that can help change their mind.
We have no choice but to live in the times that we live in, and to make it better one day at a time, one choice at a time.
**Never, ever think that any choice or act of yours is too small. It isn't.**
Regimes and autocracies are taken down by millions of drops of small actions that would otherwise be invisible by masses of people.
This is the assignment that we have ahead of us. I look forward to doing this work with you all.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260413.kwLDPe&refcode=em20260413-11169-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=11169%2E2526796%2Eclwrk1)
Our main project now is to **unite the working class in this country against a fascist agenda**. Period.
[Help us continue the fight by making a grassroots donation.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260413.kwLDPe&refcode=em20260413-11169-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=11169%2E2526796%2Eclwrk1)

In solidarity,
Alexandria

subject: Ilhan’s seat is under threat
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260413-2150-foote&t=1001&akid=2150%2E342411%2EW7sP-f ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

Trump unleashed ICE into Minnesota — and the results were devastating.
Communities torn apart, families separated, neighborhoods destroyed, and
innocent lives lost. The trauma and fear left behind are still felt today.

Now, a former ICE prosecutor is running to challenge Ilhan’s seat. It’s a
direct threat to the leaders who have fought tirelessly for our
communities, our rights, and our future.

Someone who was part of a system that caused so much harm wants to take
the place of a champion who has stood up for justice, equality, and
safety.

We cannot allow that to happen — we deserve leaders who fight for us, not
against us. Leaders who prioritize protecting families over punishing
them. Leaders who invest in solutions that build stronger neighborhoods
rather than tearing them down.

Ilhan is that leader, and now it’s up to us to ensure she stays in
Congress.

The Squad Victory Fund is mobilizing to protect her seat. We’re
organizing, reaching voters, and building the grassroots power necessary
to fight back against candidates who represent fear, division, and
destruction. But we can’t do it without you.

subject: BREAKING: Trump's executive order

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

name: Sarah McBride
subject: My bipartisan bill to expand access to essential hygiene products
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
No one should have to choose between basic hygiene and putting food on the table.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3101%2E21716%2Ec2SNth)
**No one should have to choose between basic hygiene and putting food on the table.** But right now, too many families are forced to make that exact choice.
I’ve heard from parents skipping essentials for themselves so their kids can have what they need. And from students missing school because they don’t have access to basic hygiene products.
But dignity shouldn’t depend on your income. Which is why I’ve just introduced bipartisan legislation to expand access to essential hygiene products.
**The TANF Hygiene Access Act** will help test smart, accountable solutions that get necessities like soap, diapers, feminine hygiene products, and other household necessities into the hands of families who need them while ensuring taxpayer dollars are used effectively.
This is what government should be about. When we help meet people’s basic needs, we’re helping families live with dignity, remain secure, stay healthy, and care for their families.
[**If you’re on board, will you add your name to my petition today calling on my colleagues in Congress to pass this bipartisan legislation as soon as possible?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-20260413-tanf/?source=em20260413-3101&t=2&akid=3101%2E21716%2Ec2SNth)

clean_body: Seth has a plan and he's fighting for it. | | Hey friend, Families cannot wait for change — because the challenges they face aren’t slowing down. That's why Seth has introduced the most progressive affordability agenda of any elected official in Congress. Housing, healthcare, and education are human rights — it’s not a debate. But right now, families across Massachusetts are choosing between rent, medicine, and filling up the gas tank. The cost of living keeps climbing, and the people in Washington keep treating affordability like something they'll get to eventually. Seth isn't waiting. The American Affordability Agenda tackles all of it: housing costs, drug prices, pre-k, workforce training, and pays for it by making the ultra-wealthy pay their fair share. Seth is backing it up with action, not just words. He led a bipartisan coalition of 116 members of Congress to push for full funding of Amtrak and passenger rail, because connecting communities, creating jobs, and building affordable transit is part of how you actually bring costs down. ### **The Strongman Fell --As All Inevitably Do--And Autocrats Are Having Palpitations Worldwide**
_**by Cliff Schecter**_
I'll never forget taking a trip to Romania as a consultant for the United States Information Agency's (State Department) democracy-promotion program in the mid-2000s. As part of my tour of Bucharest, we went to Revolution Square **(**_Pia ța Revoluției_**)** where bullet holes from the 1989 Romanian Revolution still scarred the visages of buildings around the square**.**
It served as a reminder of how quickly the end can come for hubristic sociopaths hiding behind the title of "leader." Not that I was thinking of anyone specifically here. 😉
Nicolae Ceaușescu, the longtime Communist Dictator of Romania was executed Christmas day 1989. Just one week beforehand, he was (ironically, due to today's headlines) on a state trip to Iran like all was normal. He was ousted in no small part because he'd lost the people with draconian policies, like food and energy rationing. He had a massive debt to contend with, as a shrinking GDP and his taste for the finer things in life--which, to be honest, _isn 't very communist-y_--had gotten him in trouble:
> Ceaușescu became obsessed with building himself a palace of unprecedented proportions, along with an equally grandiose neighborhood, Centrul Civic to accompany it.
Yes, as people were starving, the elite predator had himself constructed the second largest building--in surface area--in the world. The first? The Pentagon. There may be a message in that reality, too. But Ceaușescu wasn't satisfied with just one ridiculously lavish, enormous-arse palace, so he also built himself a whole neighborhood to surround it! Trump just put his name on the Kennedy Center so everyone could stop showing up and is constructing some little pissant ballroom.
Donald, I didn't serve with Nicolae Ceaușescu. I didn't know Nicolae Ceaușescu. Nicolae Ceaușescu was no friend of mine. And you're no Nicolae Ceaușescu.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/62a1a191-c4d3-4be5-b990-7b6d7a5ecca4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

In any case, why do I bring this up? Because here we have a man who thinks he's a dictator, is just about the most openly corrupt leader ever seen, has pardoned and protected a pedophile in his ranks, and is wrecking the economy until jobs, food, and prices of essentials are all in the crapper.
**Oh, wait, you thought I meant Donald Trump?!** Actually, I was talking about Orban! And now you see why Donald Trump should be terrified:
> ...a scandal rocked Fidesz in early 2024. Hungary's president at the time, Katalin Novak, pardoned a former official convicted of helping cover up abuse of underaged boys at a children's home. The revelation of the pardon punctured a perception of Orban's government...as the defender of Christian and family values.
> "**The core of the self-definition of Fidesz is that they are conservative, family-friendly, and they protect children, "** Peter Kreko, a political scientist who runs Political Capital, a think-tank in Budapest, told CNN. **To many voters, the pardon scandal exposed the "hypocrisy" of the Orban project**, Kreko said...
> In February 2024, Magyar gave an explosive video interview to Partizan, a Hungarian media outlet..to share information he gleaned from his proximity to government. **" A few families own half the country," he said in the interview, viewed nearly 3 million times, in a country of fewer than 10 million people.**
> While Orban's campaign this year revolved mostly around foreign policy and his relations with world leaders, **Magyar 's was rigidly focused on domestic issues, such as the economy and corruption. Over the past two years, he worked to build a direct relationship with voters, visiting scores of towns and cities, and often staying for hours after his speeches to meet local people.**

#### **ORBAN 'S TIMELY POLITICAL DEMISE**
For 16 years, Viktor Orban sold Hungarian elites--and much of the global right--a poisonous fantasy: that you could hollow out democracy, rig the media, enrich your cronies, flirt with Moscow, sneer at the European Union, even willingly spend time with the most unpleasant AI personality yet constructed, known as a "JD Vance."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/62a1a191-c4d3-4be5-b990-7b6d7a5ecca4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

And somehow call all this "the will of the people."
Orban became Trumpism's favorite export model, the patron saint of "illiberal democracy," the guy every would-be autocrat in a suit and flag pin pointed to and said, _see, this is how you do it._ _If that toad can pull it off, why not me?_ But now? He just got his clock cleaned. In a political earthquake, Peter Magyar's Tisza party didn't just beat Orban--they routed him, with the kind of parliamentary majority--nearly 70%!--that may finally give Hungary the tools to undo the constitutional vandalism Orban spent a decade and a half perfecting.
What makes this defeat monumental--and by that I mean _gorgeous_!--isn't just the seat count. It's that Orban lost _despite_ the authoritarian cheat codes he'd spent years installing like IEDs throughout this decaying democracy: media capture, gerrymandered districts, patronage networks, oligarch cash pipelines, and a political culture built on fear, grievance, and nationalist mumbo-jumbo.
This wasn't some clean, level playing field where the voters merely changed their minds over an egg-white-omelet brunch.
This was the Hungarian people kicking down in walls of a house Orban had spent years bolting shut from the inside. Record turnout--**nearly 80%** --tells the story better than any pundit ever could: people were done being ruled by a kleptocratic wannabe czar whose whole act had curdled into crony capitalism and Putin-smooching rot.
But here's the best part: **this is a flashing red warning light for the global predator class that has used Orb an as a test kitchen for democratic sabotage**. Trumpworld adored him because he proved you could turn a democracy into a family office with better goulash and great grift. The far-right in Europe loved him because he weaponized culture war bile while quietly making his friends rich. Putin loved him because Orban functioned as Moscow's house ally inside the EU, blocking aid to Ukraine and muddying Europe's response to authoritarian assholes like...Putin.
That entire axis of ego just took a major gut punch. Hungary choosing a pro-EU course under their new Prime Minister, Magyar doesn't just change Budapest--**it reverberates through Brussels, Moscow, Washington, and every billionaire-funded nationalist project that thought the future belonged to strongmen**.
Somewhere Peter Thiel is very sweaty. Though, if you've seen him before, he's a constantly fiddling overactive sweat gland on a good day--like cocaine come to life. So I'm not sure you could tell the difference.
The best part of all this? Orban's fall is a reminder that even systems built to protect power can crack when people stop accepting the lie that the strongman is inevitable. This is so important I'm tempted to repeat it.
**There is not guaranteed fate except for one we willingly accept.**
This is the lesson Democrats, pro-democracy coalitions, and frankly anyone fighting the billionaire predators running way-too-much of our world need tattooed on their frontal lobes: Like Ceaușescu, autocrats look invincible...until the day they don't. The edifice always appears permanent right up til the moment the people start puncturing it with bullet holes.
* * *
### **Autocrats fall when people stop believing the myth of inevitability.**
Viktor Orban's defeat is bigger than Hungary. It's proof that billionaire-backed strongmen can be beaten, that oligarch cash and captured media don't make a regime immortal, and that democracy still has fight left in it. Knowing this, somewhere tonight, every mini-Orban from Moscow to Mumbai is suddenly sleeping a little less soundly.
Hungary just showed the world that even one of the most polished authoritarian machines in the West _**can be beaten by those willing to stand up, put it all on the line, tell the truth, and fight every day**_.
